secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Supabase project URL — Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API. Required: the whole catalog, accounts, orders and admin panel read from this project.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key — Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API (Keys).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key — Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API (Keys). Used server-side by src/lib/supabase-admin.ts for admin/order routes. Keep secret.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name — Cloudinary Console > Settings. Optional: admin product/bio image uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key — Console > Settings > API Keys. Optional: signed uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret — Console > Settings > API Keys. Optional: signed uploads.

secrets.name: RAJAONGKIR_API_KEY
secrets.description: RajaOngkir API key (rajaongkir.com / Komerce dashboard). Optional: shipping cost + destination search. Can also be stored in the DB store_settings row.
